limitations.upstream_statement: Visible roof/road proxies cannot substantiate measured-footprint or geographic accuracy. Perspective, roof overhangs, occlusions and partial context prevent those claims. No procedural 3D geometry is constructed.
limitations.unknown_context: Only traced positive visible support can be known. Three source pixels of each boundary and explicit UI occlusions are unknown. All untraced context, negative/background absence, foliage, occluded pavement and open-space regions remain unknown; no all-known/empty artificial regions.
limitations.confidence_semantics: Conservative manual visibility scores, not calibrated probabilities or geographic/footprint measurement confidence.
